title: RVLRY: Option A selected
summary: Option A approved in chat and implemented in 0.26.2.
body:
Joe selected **Option A — Header + teams** in chat. Version **0.26.2** removes the separate round strip. The top-right header shows the round, and the numbered team boxes show progress within that round.

APK: **JNAS → Media → DropBox → RVLRY-0.26.2-prototype.apk**. Install over the existing app to preserve saves.

The four-option HTML remains a historical comparison in the same folder. This choice is resolved; use the feedback field for further comments. Responses are stored in Kestrel and do not automatically launch work.

questions.label: Any further feedback on Option A or the updated APK?
